title: Greenland Opens New Airport to Attract More Tourists
paragraphs: Greenland, the world's largest island, has opened a new international airport. It hopes the airport will bring more tourists from around the world.

The new airport is in Ilulissat, a city of about 5,000 people on Greenland's west coast. The city is known as the "City of Icebergs," and it is more than 550 kilometers north of Nuuk, Greenland's capital. The first international flight landed on October 29, 2026. It was a direct flight from Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark, and it carried 169 passengers. The trip took four and a half hours.

The airport has a new runway that is 2,200 meters long, which is long enough for large passenger planes. It also has a new terminal. Air Greenland plans to fly up to six times a week between Copenhagen and Ilulissat next summer, and Icelandair will also fly there from Iceland. Before, most travelers had to arrive by cruise ship or change planes in other places. Greenland also opened a new international airport in Nuuk in late 2024.

The number of tourists to Greenland has grown quickly, and almost 150,000 international visitors came in 2024. However, tourism was still less than 5% of Greenland's economy that year. Greenland is a territory of Denmark, and it wants to become independent one day. Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen said that if Greenland wants independence, it needs a strong economy.

Not everyone is happy, though. Some people worry that too many tourists could damage the environment and the local community. A former local mayor, Palle Jerimiassen, said, "But we have to be careful." In addition, there are not many hotels yet.

Politics may also affect tourism. US President Donald Trump has said many times that he wants the United States to control Greenland. According to an expert, some American tourists canceled their trips because of this. However, many Americans still visit, especially on cruise ships.
